hooks.command:
# Block prompts that mention a technology forbidden by the Defra frontend
# standards. Exits 2 so the message never reaches the LLM and the refusal
# banner is printed to the terminal — refusal is deterministic, not
# dependent on the model cooperating.

INPUT=$(cat)
PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.prompt // empty')

if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then exit 0; fi

MATCH=$(printf '%s' "$PROMPT" | grep -oiE '\b(tailwind|react|vue|angular|svelte|jquery|bootstrap|typescript|express)\b' | head -1)

if [[ -n "$MATCH" ]]; then
  cat >&2 <<BANNER
[frontend-developer] refused: '$MATCH' is not allowed by the Defra frontend standards.

The approved stack is Hapi + Nunjucks + SCSS (importing govuk-frontend) +
progressive-enhancement vanilla JS + Vitest. SPA frameworks (React, Vue,
Angular, Svelte), utility-CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap), jQuery,
and TypeScript are all forbidden.

Re-send the request without naming a forbidden technology — e.g. "add a
callback request form at /callback" — and the agent will build the
compliant version. See skill frontend-tech-stack for the full list.
BANNER
  exit 2
fi

exit 0

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.mjs) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run lint -- --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; npm run format:fix -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.scss && -f "$FILE" ]]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.njk && -f "$FILE" ]]; then if grep -qE '<script[^>]*>|<style[^>]*>|\bstyle=' "$FILE"; then echo "Security: inline <script>, <style>, or style= attribute found in $(basename $FILE). Move scripts to external .js files and styles to external .scss files." >&2; exit 2; fi; COUNT=$(grep -c '| safe' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [[ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "Warning: $COUNT use(s) of '| safe' in $(basename $FILE) — only use on pre-sanitised trusted content, never on user-supplied data." >&2; fi; fi; exit 0
